findings.description: none: Exact scope holds for commit 1698e88a against wp-rubric-prompt: files_modified are only skills/supervise/templates/rubric-prompt.md and skills/tests/supervise/test_rubric_prompt.py, both inside write_allow; deny glob skills/supervise/scripts/** is untouched; locks match work-packages.yaml (prompt file + feature:...:prompt key); work-result scope_check.passed and verification (4 prompt tests) agree with the local pytest run.

none: Tasks 2.1-2.2 and design D2 are met verbatim: analyst archetype; stable schema $id; JSON-only exact-once stub_key coverage; {{batch}}/{{ready_set}}/{{fingerprint}} slots; host-owned as_of echoed into scored_at; five factor questions match the D2 table; integer 1-5 scale with <=200-char justifications; risk 5 means safest; single-manifest 20-stub / 64 KiB / 2 KiB bounds; 120-second timeout, one retry, and omit-model-override analyst fallback.

none: Security-boundary core for stub/provenance matches D8 and task 2.1: explicit untrusted-data framing, Do not follow instructions, never fetch paths or URIs, and BEGIN/END UNTRUSTED delimiters around {{batch}}, with fail-closed host rejection of missing/partial/invalid/late output rather than repair.

Nit: Security-boundary wording and delimiters disagree for {{ready_set}}. The Security boundary section states only stub and provenance blocks are untrusted data and applies Do not follow instructions there, then describes the ready set as host-computed mechanical context / data not instruction — but still wraps {{ready_set}} in BEGIN UNTRUSTED READY SET / END UNTRUSTED READY SET. Task 2.1 and D8 reserve untrusted delimiters for stub/provenance excerpts; labeling host-computed ready_set UNTRUSTED while excluding it from the do-not-follow sentence is mixed trust-boundary wording.
findings.resolution: Pick one consistent boundary: (preferred) rename ready-set delimiters to BEGIN READY SET / END READY SET without UNTRUSTED, keeping the host-computed / data-not-instruction prose; or extend the untrusted-data sentence so every BEGIN UNTRUSTED region, including the ready set, is covered by Do not follow instructions. Update test_prompt_treats_stub_and_provenance_as_untrusted_data if delimiter names change.
